gate_rules.analysis_gate: Historical four-paper KRT8 pilot remains separately unexecuted/unresolved; any new analysis needs its own explicit question, biological units, eligibility checks and specification. Existing later analyses do not depend on retroactively completing that pilot.
gate_rules.stop_rule: Read one paper to answer one defined question, write an evidence/limitation/interest card, then choose the next. Literature exploration is open independently of an analysis gate; do not infer owner reading from an executed analysis.
gate_rules.gate_3A_condition: Reading open. Niethamer/S1 remains unrun; a new cytokine-phase analysis needs eligible animal-level data and a prespecified contrast. W1 or A12 does not establish a cytokine-specific mechanism.
gate_rules.gate_3B_condition: Reading open. Niethamer/D1 remains unrun; Treg analysis needs a verified external cohort, separable Tregs and independent biological units. Current lung/HLCA coverage has not passed that gate.
gate_rules.gate_2X_condition: Literature-only comparison branch. A paper, one-page evidence card and a question may justify a separate feasibility review; they do not authorize a new numerical run or claim.
